preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid node indices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in operations)
preconditions.description: All operation indices ai and bi must be valid node indices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= ci <= n - 1 for ci in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each output integer ci must be a valid count of common numbers between nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(ci == 0 for ci in map(int, stdout.split()) if ci == 0)
postconditions.description: Nodes with no common numbers must have a count of 0.
